sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Domino Legend are straightforward yet challenging. Players take turns laying dominoes from their hand, with the goal of creating a line of connected dominoes. The game features two main variations: Block and Draw. In Block, players draw a set number of dominoes at the start of the game and must use all of them before their turn is over. In Draw, players draw a domino at the start of each turn and must use it immediately.

The gameplay is turn-based, with players taking turns laying dominoes until one player has used all of their dominoes or has no legal plays left. The game ends when one player has won, and the winner is the player with the fewest number of points at the end of the game. Points are awarded for each domino left in a player's hand at the end of the game.

Domino Legend also features a variety of special dominoes, including doubles and wild dominoes. Doubles can be placed in any direction, while wild dominoes can be used as any number. These special dominoes add a layer of strategy to the game, as players must carefully consider when to use them to maximize their chances of winning.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Domino Legend are simple yet engaging. The game requires strategy and skill to win, making it appealing to players of all ages and skill levels.
